source: Source-informed VPM redesign of cache ownership, theme resolution, global stylesheet lifecycle and CSS-prop/ClassNames rendering. Upstream sources and tests informed the behavior; this is not a clean-room claim. JSX export adapters, labels, static hoisting, diagnostic wording and public declarations retain their existing source-informed implementations and attribution.
changes: Shared StyleBatch rendering plans serve CSS-prop and ClassNames insertion; GlobalSheet owns mount, hydration, replacement and disposal. A common cache provider path and component-local theme memoization replace the former close translations.
On vemotion-cache, vemotion-serialize, vemotion-utils and vemotion-use-insertion-effect-with-fallbacks. ThemeProvider no longer needs vemotion-weak-memoize; four direct dependencies remain.
No macro entry or dependency on @emotion/babel-plugin, babel-plugin-macros, cosmiconfig or @babel/runtime. Static hoisting remains internal.
Declarations on React's React.JSX namespace (@types/react 18.2.7 and later), checked with React 18.3 and 19 types.
The #is-development and #is-browser conditions choose development or production and browser or server behavior, as in the original's conditional builds.
ES modules with bundled declarations; React is a peer.

verification.upstreamSuite: Node 24 complete fixture: React 16 development 413 pass, 2 existing Babel-plugin differences, 8 skipped; React 18 development 416 pass, the same 2 differences, 5 skipped; production 5 pass and 418 skipped. The retained Jest runner does not load VPM ES modules under Bun; Bun coverage uses the focused, differential and caller probes.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles a TSX application (css prop through jsxImportSource, Global, ClassNames, theming, keyframes, and two expected errors) against the declarations with DOM and React 18.3 and 19 types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.
verification.application: Ten identical MUI system 7.2.0 / React 19.1.0 HTML/CSS renders against upstream on Node 24 and Bun. RootThemeProvider uses the cache provider and MUI supplies theming/GlobalStyles; FramedDemo supplies an iframe cache.
verification.regressions: react-lifecycle.cjs reproduces shared theme-function results across independent upstream renders and wrong-document Global hydration, then checks VPM updates and cleanup. Exercises 20,000 nested class arrays, shared arrays and explicit cycle rejection. Original Node overflows on the deep array; Bun tolerates that depth. Three package tests run on both runtimes.
verification.benchmark: Five server rendering cases and the full styled caller run in selected-implementation processes with balanced order, identical-source controls, output validation and recursive source hashes.

implementation.basis: Replaces the close translations of context, theming, Global, css-prop insertion and ClassNames with component-owned state and shared rendering plans. Upstream source inspection is acknowledged; matching diagnostic text and protocol fields are retained.
implementation.scope: VentiMath/MUI cache and theme providers, Global styles including iframe hydration, CSS-prop rendering, ClassNames, JSX runtimes and server rendering.
retainedComponents: JSX adapters and css/keyframes serialization wrappers
upstream-compatible public declarations and diagnostic text
